svg.text: RunJam · AI Coding Agent Unified Manager
Tauri 2 + Vue 3 + Rust · Local-First · Multi-Agent · Protocol Auto-Conversion

g.text: • Stream events to FE via emit
🔁 Key Data Flow (User → Session → ACP → CLI → Proxy → Provider)
Provider → Proxy (SSE stream) → AcpEvent → SessionManager.emit → Vue FE render (Markdown/Tool/Thinking)
Side effects: usage tracking → cost calc → SQLite (token_usage table) → in-memory response cache
• Local-First: ~/.runjam/ holds db · logs · sessions · acp · skills
• Protocol Auto-Conversion: configure once → all CLIs use the same model set via proxy
• Zero-config: auto-detect PATH · one-click install · bundled Node.js + llama-server
• Privacy: opt-in telemetry · local SQLite · no cloud lock-in
